blocks.text: I am starting this thread for status on the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} positioning work, so that updates, questions, and approvals stay in one place. The kickoff memo is attached for reference; it sets out the work plan and the people on our side.

Where things stand: the audit is well under way. We have been through the materials your team sent and the company's recent coverage, and we have now held most of the leadership interviews. The findings memo will follow once the remaining interviews are done, and it will set out what we heard, where the interviews and the current materials agree, and where they do not.

Three items from your side would help us finish this part of the work:
1. Times for the interviews that are still open.
2. The most recent investor presentation, if it differs from the version on the website.
3. The names of anyone besides you who should receive the findings memo.
The open interview times set the pace for everything after them, so if you can send those first, I will build the rest of the schedule around them.
